sources.title: GitHub - XinMing0212/so101-ros-ai-humble: SO101 ROS 2 Humble real-robot ...
sources.snippet: A ROS 2 Humble and LeRobot project for SO101 single arm, dual arm, and mobile dual arm (whole body) robots. It also includes voice task control and a two degree of freedom camera head. The workflow covers leader and follower teleoperation, ROS bag recording, LeRobot dataset conversion, policy training, and inference on real hardware.
